title: What It Actually Looks Like to Lead the Room and Take the Smallest Seat
caption:
Luke 14 says take the lowest seat, not the highest. Let the host move you up if he wants to.

Christ washed feet the night before he died. The King did the towel work nobody else wanted.

Leadership that skips the towel isn't leadership. It's a title.

Take the small seat. Do the work anyway.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #leadership #scripture
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
